meta.revisionPolicy: Revised continuously; finalised over ~3 years. Vintages are kept.
meta.coverage: All-India, annual GVA by industry: the 11 industries of the revised estimates and the 8 groups of the advance estimates, levels, real growth and share of nominal GVA
meta.note: MoSPI publishes years standing at a revised estimate by the finer industries only; for those years this group is the sum of its two published industries (listed in derived). The 11 finer industries end at the last year standing at a revised estimate; advance and provisional estimates publish only the 8 groups. Real growth is computed from constant-price levels; shares are of nominal total GVA.
